# Power budget

Supplies recorded: **Behringer CP1A power supply** (rated: +12V 1000 mA, -12V 1000 mA, +5V 500 mA); **Cre8audio NiftyCASE** (peak: +12V 1500 mA, -12V 500 mA, +5V 500 mA).

Assumption: every module marked in use is installed and running at once (25 modules with specs). Which module sits in which case, and which supply feeds it, is not recorded. So each supply is compared with the **whole** load, and a combined column shows the best case where the load can be split perfectly. This is a paper budget from published figures, not a measurement.

| Rail | Total draw (mA) | Behringer CP1A power supply alone | Cre8audio NiftyCASE alone | All supplies combined | Modules with no figure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| +12V | 1189 | 1000 (119%) | 1500 (79%) | 2500 (48%) | 0 |
| -12V | 548 | 1000 (55%) | 500 (110%) | 1500 (37%) | 0 |
| +5V | 49 (lower bound) | 500 (10%) | 500 (10%) | 1000 (5%) | 6 |

Percentages are draw as a share of capacity. A rail marked *lower bound* omits modules whose figure no source stated. Case figures are labelled *peak* by the maker; continuous capacity may be lower.

**Width:** 233 HP of standard 3U modules, plus 60 HP-equivalent of 1U-format (Intellijel) modules as listed by ModularGrid, which sit in a separate 1U row. Case space recorded: Cre8audio NiftyCASE 84 HP. The modules total more than that, so some live in a case or rack that is not recorded here.

**Connections:** 25 modules counted; recorded power connections: Behringer CP1A power supply 14, Cre8audio NiftyCASE 10. Extra distribution boards, if any, are not recorded.
